about: Where card32.px.js stamps the approved stockart32 parts and which of their pixels stay visible. The parts are regenerated from art/stockart32/characters.json with its reviewed masks and must equal the digests data/stockart32/digests.json records; their pixels are never tracked here. Every visible part pixel must show in the render and in the built ROM's own screen bytes.

placements.why: the cream rail on row 96 tops the left stands
the cream rail on row 96 tops the right stands
the ticket counter hides the cropped lower edge from row 200; the card ledge covers rows 156-159, which the part leaves clear
